noticeDescription:
City of Toronto Act, 2006 Public Notice 
Next Generation 911 Fee

 

Toronto City Council will be considering recommendations which may result in future amendments to City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 441, Fees and Charges.

 

It is proposed that recommendations be considered at the City Council meeting to be held on December 9 and 10, 2026 or at a subsequent meeting. If adopted by City Council, subject to the execution of agreements with telecommunications carriers, there will be amendments to Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 441, Fees and Charges which will:

 

  • Introduce a Next Generation 911 monthly service fee of $2 per wireless (mobile) subscriber to support investments in emergency services, with a target implementation date of October 1, 2027.
     

The proposed recommendations are outlined in the report titled “Advancing Implementation of the Long-Term Financial Plan – Revenue Opportunities”. To view a copy of the report, please visit the City’s website at: https://secure.toronto.ca/council/#/committees/3031/28420

 

The Executive Committee will hear public deputations from any person, or their counsel, agent or solicitor, who wishes to speak to the matter at the following meeting, to be held in person and via video conference:

 

Date:              December 1, 2026

Time:              9:30 a.m.

Location:        Video Conference or Committee Room 1, Toronto City Hall, 2nd Floor, 100 Queen Street West 

 

To submit comments or make a presentation to the Executive Committee meeting on December 1, 2026, please visit https://secure.toronto.ca/council/agenda-item.do?item=2027.EX1.3

 

Any comments received after the Committee meeting will be forwarded to City Council.

 

While the staff report sets out the proposed changes, the Committee and/or City Council may change these proposals and adopt additional or other amendments that differ from the recommendations in the report. The proposed amendments are subject to the decisions of the Committee and City Council.

 

If this matter is postponed at the Committee or City Council meeting or considered at a subsequent Committee or City Council meeting, no additional notice will be provided other than the information on the subsequent Committee or City Council agenda. Please contact the above City officials if you require notice in these cases.

 

The Executive Committee will make its recommendations on December 1, 2026, which will be forwarded for consideration to City Council for its meeting on December 9 and 10, 2026 or at a subsequent meeting.

 

To ask questions regarding the content of the report, please contact:

 

Lauren Birch
Director, Financial Strategy and Policy
Office of the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer
Email: lauren.birch@toronto.ca

Telephone: 416-392-4258

 

Notice to people writing to, communicating with or making presentations to Executive Committee:

 

The City of Toronto Act, 2006 and the City of Toronto Municipal Code authorize the City of Toronto to collect any personal information in your communication or presentation to City Council or its committees. The City collects this information to enable it to make informed decisions on the relevant issue(s). If you are submitting letters, faxes, e-mails, presentations or other communications to the City, you should be aware that your name and your comments with the City will become part of the public record and will appear on the City's website. The City will also make your communication and any personal information in it - such as your postal address, telephone number or e-mail address - available to the public, unless you expressly request the City to remove it.

 

Many Committee, Board, and Advisory Body meetings are broadcast live over the internet for the public to view. If you speak at the meeting you will appear in the video broadcast. Video broadcasts are archived and continue to be publicly available.

 

If you want to learn more about why and how the City collects your information, write to the City Clerk's Office, City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, Toronto ON M5H 2N2 or call 416-392-4666.
